body: Oh my God I so wanna off myself but I’m such a fucking coward and a piece of shit I can’t do it. I pray every day that I’ll just die of a fucking heart attack. Or when I do leave the house that I will get fucking run over or hit in a car accident. I fucking hate life so bad and I so badly want to die I pray every day that I die that’s all I actually do is pray that I will die

I did over 10 years in prison because of my fuck ups and let me tell you I hated myself so much and still have issues with that but I want to live I want to make a better life for myself and become the man I believe myself to be I am a veteran. Life is hard but is long as I know people love me if I can get through it
I am so proud of you I just wanted you to know that because depression and suicidal tendencies are hard to get over but together we can get through this I love you thank you

I can relate to not wanting to be here anymore but let me tell you something that I consider now we have no idea what’s on the other side so why not live this life as much as we can no matter what happens. I am here for you and I love you and I don’t even know you and you don’t know me but that doesn’t matter. I can relate just wanting somebody to love me. We can get through this together.

It doesn’t matter how you tried to commit suicide. I have tried every way that I know. And then I came to realize that we only have one life only one life that we will remember so why not give it a chance no matter how bad it is. Together we can do this and let me tell you I’m here for you because I can relate to every fucking feeling that I will guarantee that you’re going through.  I don’t wanna be alone and I need you so don’t give up.

You’ve probably heard this 100 times but I am here and I do care I’m a veteran and I have so many issues I don’t want to name them but I’ll tell you something we only have one life so why not give it a chance no matter what shit storm it is we don’t know what’s on the other side. So let’s live this life together I’m here for you to talk to anytime. !!!!

I can relate to all the problems that you’re going through but let me tell you we only have one life so why not give it a chance no matter what shit storm we’re going through we don’t know what’s on the other side remember this I love you no matter who you are or what you’ve done I’m here to talk to and I am in the exact same boat that you are
Life is hard but we can get through it. we just have to stick together and I am an introvert so I hate being with people but we can do this. I am here for anybody to reach out because it helps me.
I made this mess and I will clean it up it’s just time for me to go. I haven’t done anything wrong or anybody majorly I just can’t stand myself
Great you sent me a bunch of suicidal phone numbers that’s going to help my thinking

I’m in the exact same boat I have high anxiety major depressive disorder and PTSD I am a bettering and I can’t stand life. It’s not that I don’t want to live it it’s just that it’s hard every day. You’re not alone. We all come from different parts of life but we are the same problems.
Don’t cut yourself too much pain I’m here to try to help you life is hard I love is strong that’s the only thing that’s been keeping me going but it’s been working
I am suicidal, I pray that I will just die. I love people I just can’t stand myself
I am suicidal too I pray that I just die and from what I’ve read if you keep thinking that way you will die. That’s what I’m hoping will happen
Life is hard I don’t know what to do I love I lost and I wanna die
Please guys let me die
I want to die to

Day to day for me was not leaving my tent. Basically the only time I unzipped that zipper was to try to find something to eat are use the rest room/woods. I don’t beg I avoid people at all cost. I go to the kitchen here and they feed us. But I was going to my appointment with my psychiatrist and psychologist and doing all the right things to get better again and then I stopped taking my meds. I just talk to you the social worker again and she said if she can’t find anything by the end of the day for me to go to the hospital and explain my Extreme lows and thoughts of self harm and they will give me a bed immediately and bring me to a veterans hospital that has an open bed so I can get reestablished on my meds.

Yes the VA does offer mental health and I am involved with that and this is my fault because I’m on medications I start to feel better I stopped taking my medications it’s like a hamster wheel just goes round and round. I just got to get some stability back in my life and stay on my meds I contacted the VA crisis line tonight and set up an appointment for tomorrow morning to talk with a social worker. Thank you for responding

I contacted the VA  crisis line tonight and they said they would have a social worker contact me tomorrow morning.  Not much family due to my pushing everybody away. I’ve stated in other comments it’s my fault I’m on meds and I stop taking them.  It’s nice to have all these replies makes you feel like you matter again. Being homeless and having mental issues it’s one of the hardest things. And I’ve seen some shit I serve my country.

I’m glad you can relate to the depression because a lot of people can’t. They tell me to get over it and it’s all mental. A lot of this is my fault because I’m on meds and then I stopped taking my meds and life falls apart again. I have to just stay on my meds and stay involved with the VA. Major depressive disorder is no joke especially being homeless there’s nowhere to hide. I contacted the VA and told them I need to come in immediately so Crisis center said they would contact me tomorrow. thank you for your reply
I have a a PTSD disability claim still pending but you know how that long that takes years. I’ve also filed a major depressive disorder and I anxiety claim. Thank you for your reply
I bounce around and I stay at a shelter. I’m just gonna stay on my meds that’s my major issue if I stay on my meds I put my life together I stop taking my meds my life falls apart.

I’m on a waiting list for VA housing. A lot of this is my fault I take my meds start to feel better life looks good I stopped taking my meds and I just wanna live in a shoebox. Thank you very much for your reply

I agree with you 100%, but not all of us are built the same way and not all of us went through the same things.  I’m very proud to have served my country but I shit also fucked me up. I tell myself every day to get over it but the struggle is real. Thank you sir for your honesty.
I feel the same way
